overall_assessment: Section extraction works very well for NLA: all ten courses have correct, complete and clean course_content, learning_outcomes, teaching_methods, coursework_requirements and assessment, and arbeidskrav are correctly kept out of assessment. The pre-pass 'leak' flags on the four suspects are false alarms; only minor issues remain (progresjonskrav dropped, a lost first sub-heading, an orphaned grading-expression line). No reading_list rows are emitted, but the source only has a link label so nothing is lost.

findings.evidence: Musikk 1 modul 1 må takast før Musikk 2 modul 3.
findings.description: The 'Progresjonskrav' section states a real prerequisite (module or courses that must be completed first), but it is not extracted into prerequisites nor any other section; the text is dropped. 'Forkunnskapskrav' and 'Anbefalte forkunnskaper' are correctly captured.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The heading 'Progresjonskrav' has no pattern in R/section_heading_map.R, so it maps to nothing and is dropped.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a 'progresjonskrav' pattern mapped to prerequisites in R/section_heading_map.R (placed so it merges with Forkunnskapskrav).

findings.evidence: Studenten har kunnskap om kjenneteikn på eit mangfaldig og inkluderande læringsmiljø og om fellesskap for musikalsk læring
findings.description: When 'Kunnskap' follows the 'Læringsutbytte' heading directly (no intro sentence), the first sub-heading 'Kunnskap' is lost and the section starts at 'Studenten', so the Kunnskap group is unlabelled while Ferdigheter and Generell kompetanse keep their headings. Content survives, only the label is lost.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The heading-line consumption in R/extract_sections.R treats the line directly after 'Læringsutbytte' (the sub-heading 'Kunnskap', itself mapped as a learning-outcomes heading) as the section heading and strips it.
findings.suggested_fix: In the splitter, only drop the matched heading line itself; do not collapse consecutive heading lines that map to the same section (keep 'Kunnskap' as body text).

findings.description: The 'Vurderingsuttrykk arbeidskrav' heading is dropped but its value line is appended to the end of coursework_requirements as an orphaned 'Godkjent / Ikke godkjent' line without a label. Harmless and arguably correct placement, but it reads as noise.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Vurderingsuttrykk arbeidskrav' is mapped to coursework_requirements as a heading, whose heading text is stripped, leaving only the value.
findings.suggested_fix: Optionally keep the heading as a prefix ('Vurderingsuttrykk: Godkjent / Ikke godkjent') or drop the pass/fail line in .clean_sections().
